      • fetchProfile

        java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture<IProfile> fetchProfile(java.util.UUID uniqueId)
        Fetch the profile of a player by their UUID. If the player is online, this will return the same instance as getProfile(Player). Otherwise, it will fetch the data from the database asynchronously.
        Parameters:
        uniqueId - UUID to get the profile of
        Returns:
        CompletableFuture of the player's IProfile

      • saveProfile

        async - whether to save the profile asynchronously or not

      • refreshNametag

        void refreshNametag(org.bukkit.entity.Player player)

        Parameters:
        player - Player whose nametag should be refreshed
